messages.Terjadi kesalahan pada server. Silakan c: A server error occurred. Please try again.
messages.Sesi Anda telah berakhir. Silakan masuk: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
messages.Anda tidak memiliki izin untuk tindakan: You don't have permission for this action.
messages.Sesi kasir POS tidak memiliki akses ke B: A POS cashier session doesn't have access to the Back Office.
The session isn't valid on this device.
messages.Anda wajib mengganti password terlebih d: You must change your password first.
You don't have access to this branch.
messages.Terlalu banyak permintaan. Silakan tungg: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
messages.Permintaan tidak valid. Muat ulang halam: Invalid request. Reload the page and try again.
The request origin is not allowed.
messages.Terlalu banyak percobaan. Silakan coba l: Too many attempts. Please try again in {wait}.
{field} can have at most 2 decimal places.
messages.{field} harus bilangan bulat untuk satua: {field} must be a whole number for this unit.
{field} can have at most 3 decimal places.
messages.Tanggal awal harus sebelum tanggal akhir: The start date must be before the end date.
The report range can be at most {days} days.
messages.Jumlah per halaman harus salah satu dari: Rows per page must be one of {sizes}.
messages.{field}: pilih minimal satu cabang, atau: {field}: choose at least one branch, or apply to all branches.
messages.Anda tidak dapat mengubah pengguna denga: You can't change a user with higher access than yours.
messages.Anda tidak dapat memberikan role dengan: You can't assign a role with permissions you don't have.
messages.Anda hanya dapat menempatkan pengguna di: You can only assign users to your own branch.
messages.Terminal harus berada di cabang pengguna: The terminal must be in the user's branch.
messages.Username hanya boleh huruf kecil, angka,: Username may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens (3–50 characters).
messages.Password awal wajib diisi untuk pengguna: An initial password is required for users with Back Office access.
You don't have permission to set PINs.
messages.Anda tidak dapat mengubah role atau akse: You can't change your own account's role or access.
messages.Tetapkan password terlebih dahulu sebelu: Set a password before granting Back Office access.
messages.Anda tidak dapat menonaktifkan akun Anda: You can't deactivate your own account.
messages.Gunakan menu Ganti Password untuk akun A: Use the Change Password menu for your own account.
messages.Sesi tidak ditemukan atau sudah berakhir: Session not found or already ended.
messages.Akun Anda tidak aktif. Hubungi administr: Your account is inactive. Contact an administrator.
messages.Akun Anda tidak memiliki akses ke Backof: Your account doesn't have Back Office access.
messages.Password baru harus berbeda dari passwor: The new password must differ from the current password.
The email is already used by another user.
messages.Format foto tidak didukung. Gunakan JPG,: Unsupported photo format. Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
messages.Ukuran foto tidak valid (maks. 200 KB se: Invalid photo size (max. 200 KB after resizing).
The file isn't a valid image.
messages.Kode cabang hanya huruf, angka, dan stri: Branch codes may only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens.
The branch code is already in use.
messages.Masih ada shift kasir terbuka di cabang: There are still open cashier shifts in this branch. Close all shifts first.
messages.Kode terminal hanya huruf, angka, dan st: Terminal codes may only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens.
messages.Kode terminal sudah digunakan di cabang: The terminal code is already used in this branch.
messages.Buka shift terlebih dahulu sebelum bertr: Open a shift before making transactions.
The category name is already in use.
messages.Tanggal pengeluaran tidak boleh di masa: The expense date can't be in the future.
messages.Produk yang sama tidak boleh muncul dua: The same product can't appear twice in one document.
messages.Produk baris {row} tidak ditemukan atau: Product on row {row} not found or inactive.
The stock change for {name} can't be 0.
The source and destination branches must be different.
messages.Cabang tujuan tidak ditemukan atau nonak: Destination branch not found or inactive.
messages.Produk sumber dan produk hasil harus ber: The source and result products must be different.
messages.Produk sumber tidak ditemukan atau nonak: Source product not found or inactive.
messages.Produk hasil tidak ditemukan atau nonakt: Result product not found or inactive.
messages.Jumlah {name} terlalu kecil untuk dikonv: The quantity of {name} is too small to convert to the base unit.
messages.Kode satuan hanya huruf, angka, titik, d: Unit codes may only contain letters, numbers, dots, and hyphens.
The order must be a whole number from 0–9999.
messages.Tunai adalah metode bawaan dan tidak bis: Cash is the built-in method and can't be deactivated.
Cash is the built-in method and can't be deleted.
messages.{name} sudah dipakai di transaksi, jadi: {name} has been used in transactions, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead so it no longer appears in the POS.
messages.SKU hanya huruf, angka, titik, garis mir: SKUs may only contain letters, numbers, dots, slashes, underscores, and hyphens.
messages.Barcode hanya huruf, angka, dan strip (m: Barcodes may only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens (min. 4 characters).
messages.Satuan tambahan tidak boleh sama dengan: An additional unit can't be the same as the base unit.
messages.Konversi satuan tambahan ke-{n} harus le: The conversion for additional unit #{n} must be greater than 0.
messages.Konversi satuan maksimal 6 angka desimal: Unit conversions can have at most 6 decimal places.
messages.Barcode satuan hanya huruf, angka, dan s: Unit barcodes may only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens (min. 4 characters).
messages.Barcode yang sama dipakai lebih dari sek: The same barcode is used more than once on this product.
The barcode is already used by another product.
messages.Isi paket minimal 1 dan maksimal 20 prod: A bundle must contain 1 to 20 products.
messages.Produk isi paket tidak boleh ganda. Gabu: Bundle products can't be duplicated. Combine their quantities in one row.
messages.{name} adalah paket; paket tidak boleh b: {name} is a bundle; bundles can't contain other bundles.
messages.Produk ini menjadi isi paket lain, sehin: This product is part of another bundle, so it can't be turned into a bundle.
messages.Isi paket dan pembatasan cabang hanya un: Bundle contents and branch restrictions are only for bundle products.
messages.Kosongkan stok produk ini (penyesuaian k: Empty this product's stock (adjust to 0) before turning off stock tracking.
messages.Paket tidak bisa memakai satuan lain. Ha: Bundles can't use other units. Remove the other units first.
messages.Format gambar tidak didukung. Gunakan JP: Unsupported image format. Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
messages.Ukuran gambar tidak valid (maks. {kb} KB: Invalid image size (max. {kb} KB after resizing).
messages.Kode pairing tidak valid atau sudah keda: The pairing code is invalid or has expired.
messages.Perangkat ini belum terdaftar sebagai te: This device isn't registered as a POS terminal yet.
messages.Shift sudah terbuka di terminal atau aku: A shift is already open on this terminal or account.
Payment method #{n} is unavailable. Reload the method list in the POS.
messages.Uang diterima kurang dari nominal pembay: Cash received is less than the cash payment amount.
messages.Hanya boleh satu pembayaran tunai per tr: Only one cash payment is allowed per transaction.
messages.Produk ke-{n} tidak ditemukan atau sudah: Product #{n} not found or no longer active.
messages.Barang manual tidak diizinkan. Pilih bar: Manual items aren't allowed. Choose items from the product catalog.
The quantity of item #{n} is invalid.
messages.Harga atau promo berubah sejak keranjang: Prices or promotions changed since the cart was created. Check the latest total, then pay again.
messages.Total pembayaran harus sama dengan total: The payment total must equal the purchase total.
messages.Jumlah {name} terlalu kecil untuk mengur: The quantity of {name} is too small to reduce the stock of its contents.
Transaction not found in this branch. Check the receipt number.
messages.Barang yang sama tercantum lebih dari se: The same item is listed more than once.
The returned item isn't in this transaction.
messages.Jumlah retur {name} harus bilangan bulat: The return quantity of {name} must be a whole number.
messages.Voucher {code} berlaku untuk belanja min: Voucher {code} requires a minimum purchase of Rp{min}.
messages.Perlu persetujuan supervisor: pilih supe: Supervisor approval required: choose a supervisor and enter their PIN (or a manager's username & password).
The supervisor PIN must be 6 digits.
messages.Akun supervisor tidak aktif atau tidak p: The supervisor account is inactive or doesn't have POS access.
messages.Persetujuan harus dari atasan lain, buka: Approval must come from another manager, not {requester}.
messages.Akun ini tidak berwenang menyetujui {pur: This account isn't authorized to approve {purpose}.
messages.Supervisor harus dari cabang yang sama d: The supervisor must be from the same branch as this terminal.
Percentage discounts can be at most 100%.
messages.{name} nonaktif sehingga tidak bisa dipa: {name} is inactive, so it can't be used in a promotion.
messages.Tanggal mulai harus sebelum atau sama de: The start date must be on or before the end date.
messages.{field} harus 0–100 dengan maksimal 2 de: {field} must be 0–100 with at most 2 decimals.
The tax ID may only contain digits, dots, and hyphens.
The display view is too large.
messages.Kode display tidak valid atau sudah keda: The display code is invalid or has expired. Create a new code on the cashier screen.
This display isn't connected to a cashier yet.
messages.Tautan pendaftaran tidak berlaku lagi. M: The sign-up link is no longer valid. Ask the cashier to show a new QR code.
messages.Data Anda sudah terkirim ke kasir. Terim: Your details have already been sent to the cashier. Thank you!
messages.Isi jam mulai dan jam selesai, atau koso: Fill in both the start and end time, or leave both blank to apply all day.
messages.Jam mulai dan jam selesai tidak boleh sa: The start and end time can't be the same.
messages.Voucher {code} hanya berlaku pukul {from: Voucher {code} is only valid from {from} to {to}.
messages.Pilih produk atau kategori yang mendapat: Choose the products or categories that get the discount.
messages.Produk dalam promo kombinasi tidak boleh: Products in a combo promotion can't be duplicated. Combine their quantities.
messages.Potongan barang yang didapat maksimal 10: The discount on the received item can be at most 100% (free).
messages.Kode voucher hanya huruf, angka, strip,: Voucher codes may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores (no spaces).
messages.Kuota voucher harus bilangan bulat 1 ata: The voucher quota must be a whole number of 1 or more.
messages.Promo kombinasi satu produk minimal 2 un: A single-product combo needs at least 2 units (e.g. 3 Iced Teas for Rp10,000). For a single-product discount, use Product Discount.
The voucher code is already used by another voucher.
messages.Jenis promo tidak bisa diubah. Buat prom: The promotion type can't be changed. Create a new promotion.
messages.Promo ini sudah dipakai di transaksi. No: This promotion has been used in transactions. Deactivate it instead to keep the sales history intact.
messages.Jatuh tempo tidak boleh sebelum tanggal: The due date can't be before the purchase date.
messages.{name} adalah paket dan tidak bisa dibel: {name} is a bundle and can't be purchased. Buy its content products.
messages.{name} ({code}) muncul lebih dari sekali: {name} ({code}) appears more than once. Combine the quantities in one row.
messages.Pembayaran hanya dapat dicatat bila bara: Payments can only be recorded when goods are received immediately.
messages.Pembayaran hanya untuk pembelian yang su: Payments are only for purchases that have been received.
messages.Nominal melebihi sisa hutang ({remaining: The amount exceeds the remaining payable ({remaining}).
messages.Hanya pembelian berstatus draft yang dap: Only draft purchases can be edited.
messages.Hanya draft yang dapat dibatalkan. Pembe: Only drafts can be cancelled. Received purchases are corrected through stock adjustments.
